verdict.rationale: Bitbucket detects vulnerabilities through its Snyk security-scan integration and has an AI code reviewer that suggests fixes on code changes. It also offers AI-powered pipeline workflows for tasks like fixing flaky tests. Nothing in the evidence links these AI features to security findings, and the AI only suggests fixes rather than applying them automatically. Missing for 10: AI-generated fixes specifically for detected security vulnerabilities, automatic application of those fixes, documentation linking Snyk or other scan findings to AI remediation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
